solution:
names = ["温度记录", "考试成绩", "图片标注", "语音片段"]
values = [120, 86, 240, 64]
threshold = 86

picked = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    if values[i] >= threshold:
        picked.append(names[i])

print(picked)
